attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as a router between two VLANs: node1-eth1 (192.168.10.1/24) faces node2's VLAN, node1-eth2 (192.168.20.1/24) faces node3's VLAN. node2-eth1 got 192.168.10.2/24 with a static route to 192.168.20.0/24 via node1; node3-eth1 got 192.168.20.2/24 with a static route to 192.168.10.0/24 via node1. IPv4 forwarding was enabled globally and per-interface on node1. All config was made persistent (SONiC /etc/network/interfaces.d + /etc/sysctl.d on node1; NetworkManager connection profiles on node2/node3). Verified node2 and node3 can ping each other across the VLAN boundary (TTL=63, confirming routing through node1). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id and health, issued a native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and re-verified the routed interfaces/forwarding sysctls/cross-VLAN ping recovered after each restart.
